params.name: number
params.description: Policy number that uniquely identifies the policy to read.

items.docs: Read a policy by its policy number. A policy aggregates one or more coverage lines (subjects) under a shared number; each subject carries its own effective/expiration dates and computed validity status. Scoped to the caller's organization. Use the policy sub-routes (`/amendments`, `/documents`, `/cancellations`, `/reinstatements`) for related entities.

List amendments (cancellations and reinstatements) for a policy identified by its number. Each amendment is either a cancellation that reduces or ends coverage, or a reinstatement that restores coverage after a cancellation. Supports pagination via `limit` and `skip`.

params.name: number
params.description: Policy number identifying the policy to cancel.

items.docs: Apply a cancellation to a policy, suppressing the validity of the targeted subjects from the effective date forward. This is a state-changing operation: it creates a cancellation modifier and updates subject validity accordingly. To record an externally-issued cancellation without altering platform state, use the `/log` variant instead.

params.name: number
params.description: Policy number identifying the policy whose cancellation is being logged.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the cancellation request being recorded as logged.

items.docs: Record an externally-issued cancellation against an existing cancellation request. This is an audit-only operation: no policy state is changed. Use the non-`/log` POST variant if you need to apply a new cancellation that updates subject validity.

params.name: number
params.description: Policy number identifying the policy from which the cancellation should be removed.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the cancellation to delete.

items.docs: Delete a previously-applied policy cancellation. Removing the cancellation reverses its effect on subject validity, so any subjects it was suppressing become valid again subject to the policy's other modifiers.

params.name: number
params.description: Policy number identifying the policy to reinstate.

items.docs: Apply a reinstatement to a policy, reversing an active cancellation and restoring the covered subjects to compliant status. This is a state-changing operation: it creates a reinstatement modifier and updates subject validity accordingly. To record an externally-issued reinstatement without altering platform state, use the `/log` variant instead.

params.name: number
params.description: Policy number identifying the policy whose reinstatement is being logged.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the reinstatement request being recorded as logged.

items.docs: Record an externally-issued reinstatement against an existing reinstatement request. This is an audit-only operation: no policy state is changed. Use the non-`/log` POST variant if you need to apply a new reinstatement that updates subject validity.

params.name: number
params.description: Policy number identifying the policy from which the reinstatement should be removed.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the reinstatement to delete.

items.docs: Delete a previously-applied policy reinstatement. Removing the reinstatement re-asserts the underlying cancellation, so subjects that were restored by it return to suppressed status (subject to the policy's other modifiers).
